verdict.rationale: Month-end close is a fair axis for bookkeeping software like sevDesk, but the evidence pack never mentions a close checklist, accrual tracking, or review sign-offs. Bank-payment matching, missing-receipt alerts and tax-advisor collaboration are adjacent features, not a close workflow, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As an accountant, I can run a month-end close against a checklist that tracks reconciliations, accruals, and review sign-offs
